name: Kami-Con
blurb: A three-day Japanese-culture convention at the BJCC in Birmingham with anime, manga, gaming, cosplay and an interactive ongoing story.

editions.venue: Birmingham-Jefferson Convention Complex (BJCC), East Exhibit Halls

picks: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic, Powerpuff Girls

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'Kami-Con takes place February 12-14, 2027!' and 'Kami-Con is held annually at the BJCC in Birmingham, Alabama. We are located in the East Exhibit Halls.'

notes: This is the 18th Kami-Con (filenames prefixed 'KC18'). Guests page lists only one confirmed guest so far, Lauren Faust, directly under a 'SPECIAL GUESTS' heading; guests is still 'announced' since one real guest is already picked. Cover uses the page's own full-width 'KC18-KeyArt-Full-Web4.jpg' hero image, named as key art for this edition. Refute pass (2026-10-05): upheld -- a fresh re-check still shows only Lauren Faust on the Special Guests page (no 'more coming soon' tile even present now); websearch confirms Kami-Con's already-concluded Season 17 (2026, Feb 6-8, Birmingham) had a different, already-announced lineup (Tia Ballard, Trina Nishimura, Zeno Robinson, Brittney Karbowski, Justin Cook, Kaiji Tang) that does NOT include Lauren Faust, and that she was separately announced specifically for Kami-Con's 'Season 18' guest announcements (Season 18 = this Feb 2027 edition), so this is not a leftover from last season.
